title: Chargeback & Marketplace Credit Intake: Triage Flow and Decision Matrix
creator: Ava Chen
description: Purpose: Define a differentiated triage and routing flow for enterprise chargeback requests, marketplace credit adjustments, and cost-allocation exceptions. Scope excludes bug fixes to billing systems; focuses on policy decisions, routing to Finance/Legal/Sales, SLA commitments for enterprise invoices, and one-off marketplace credits. Goals: 1) Reduce back-and-forth between G&A, Sales, and PM by providing deterministic routing rules; 2) Provide a decision matrix that balances revenue risk with operational overhead; 3) Implement handoff artifacts and SLA targets so Customer Success and Sales can give consistent responses to customers. Out of scope: automated invoicing system bugs, technical payment processor integrations, and refunds for public/non-enterprise marketplace purchases.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic triage flow document exists and is validated by Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations
Routing rules implemented as a triage checklist used by CS and Sales (internal Confluence template)
SLAs defined for triage response (initial ack <= 2 business days, decision <= 7 business days for non-complex requests)
Decision matrix includes thresholds for escalation (>$50k, recurring commitment changes, regulatory constraints)
At least two recent customer requests are classified using the matrix with outcomes logged in the demo playbook
triage_flow: Step 1: Intake channel (support ticket flagged as "billing/chargeback" or dedicated intake form) -> Step 2: Initial PM/RevOps quick-screen (same-day) using the triage checklist -> Step 3: Categorize request as: a) Simple credit (automatable, < $1k), b) Chargeback/Allocation (requires Finance sign-off), c) Commitment/Marketplace policy exception (requires Sales + Legal), d) Strategic multi-tenant cost allocation change (requires Eng + Platform). -> Step 4: Route to primary owner: Finance for refunds/credits, Revenue Ops for cost allocation, Sales for contract/commitment changes, Legal for regulatory or contract clause changes, Eng for telemetry/data needed to validate usage. -> Step 5: Commit timeline and follow-ups in ticket, update customer-facing owner. -> Step 6: Post-resolution: log the case in the chargeback registry, tag pattern for product/console telemetry improvements if recurring.
decision_matrix_summary: Primary axes: Monetary exposure (one-time and ARR impact), Frequency (one-off vs recurring), Contracted terms (exists vs no-signed commitment), Compliance risk, Implementation effort. Example rules: - Auto-approve credits <= $1k and one-off; Finance auto-process within 3 business days. - For requests between $1k and $50k, require Revenue Ops review and PM sign-off; decision target 7 business days. - >$50k or any request that changes recurring commitment requires Sales + Finance + PM review and Legal if contract wording is implicated. - Marketplace credits tied to partner fees must route to Partner Ops and Marketplace PM. - Cost allocation changes that impact internal chargeback models require Eng and Billing infra involvement and are scheduled as scoped projects (not immediate credits).
routing_rules: If request type == "marketplace-credit" -> route to Marketplace PM + Partner Ops
If monetary_exposure < 1000 AND one_off == true -> Finance auto-process (tag: finance-auto)
If monetary_exposure between 1000 and 50000 -> Revenue Ops assignment + PM review
If request alters committed ARR or billing cadence -> Sales + Finance + PM escalation
If any legal/PII/regulatory concern -> include Legal; pause auto-processing until Legal review
follow_up_tasks: Build Confluence intake template and triage checklist (owner: PM)
Add triage tags and routing automation to Support workspace (owner: RevOps)
Create a short CS playbook with canned responses and SLAs (owner: Customer Success)
Instrument a chargeback registry dashboard in Looker with tag-based filters (owner: Analytics)
Draft Legal guidance snippets for common contract amendments (owner: Legal)
Schedule a pilot run for next 4 weeks with Sales and five active enterprise customers (owner: PM)
Capture two anonymized case studies and add to runbook (owner: PM)
Identify engineering telemetry gaps required to validate marketplace usage for credits (owner: Eng)
Define a policy for marketplace fee offsets vs direct credits (owner: Marketplace PM)
Add triage outcomes to monthly ops review and iterate thresholds (owner: RevOps)
Create a lightweight FAQ and public KB entry for self-serve small credits (<$1k) (owner: Docs)
Map SLA tracking to Console -> customer-facing ticket notes updated at each stage (owner: Console)
Measure baseline: time-to-decision and financial exposure for the last 90 days (owner: Analytics)
